desc: Derive and justify that an operation swaps gap indices \(i\) and \(i+2\), establishing independent arbitrary permutations of odd and even gap positions.
Derive the weighted coordinate-sum objective and use rearrangement/exchange argument to determine the optimal sorted assignment within each parity class.
Implement the 64-bit-safe \(O(N\log N)\) stdin/stdout Python solution and verify it against both samples.
